Name: Robert Murray M'Cheyne
Summary: Scottish minister of St Peter's, Dundee, who died at twenty-nine; his daily Bible-reading plan, taking readers through the Old Testament once and the New Testament and Psalms twice a year, is still widely used.
Contribution: Gave the church its most enduring Bible-reading plan and a model of youthful, prayerful pastoral ministry in Scotland.
Testimony: He testified that holiness and prayer, not mere activity, were the minister's first work.
